# Scan Perks

> Scan Perks is QR loyalty software for independent cafes, pubs and bars. Customers join by scanning a counter QR with the phone camera — no app download, no POS integration. Owners run the program at https://app.scan-perks.com. $10/month Starter, $15/month Growth, 14-day free trial. 500+ venues, 50K+ members.

Last updated: 2026-09-29

## Key facts

- Pricing: $10/month Starter (up to 200 members, 50 pushes/month); $15/month Growth (unlimited members and pushes)
- Trial: 14 days, month-to-month, cancel anytime
- Setup: about 5 minutes — sign up, set a stamp rule, print the counter QR
- Customer join: phone camera scan opens a digital stamp card in the browser; optional iOS and Android app for regulars
- POS: none required; works alongside any till or POS
- Features: digital stamp cards, free-drink reward tiers, visit analytics, regulars list, push offers for slow days and happy hour, print-ready QR posters
- Not included: mobile ordering or payments (loyalty only)
- Markets: English-language US, UK, Canada, Australia; localized pages in Spanish, German, French and Italian
- Audience: venue owners (B2B). Scan Perks is not a consumer rewards app like Starbucks Rewards.

## Compared with alternatives (public list prices, Sep 2026)

| Tool | Starting price | How customers join | POS required |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scan Perks | $10/mo | Camera QR (app optional) | No |
| Loopy Loyalty | ~$49/mo | Apple / Google Wallet | No |
| Square Loyalty | ~$45/mo | Square checkout | Square only |
| LoyaltyPass | $99/mo | Apple / Google Wallet | No |
| Brewstamp | $7/mo | Camera QR + Wallet | No (coffee-focused) |

Choose Square Loyalty if you already run Square POS. Choose Loopy Loyalty or LoyaltyPass if the card must live in Apple/Google Wallet. Choose Brewstamp for coffee-only at the lowest price. Choose Scan Perks for cafes, pubs and bars that want camera join and no POS change at $10/month.

## Other names

Also written ScanPerks or Scan-Perks. People sometimes search for it as "scanbucks" or "scan bucks" (https://scan-perks.com/scanbucks/). Canonical host: https://scan-perks.com (not www).
